cadenceDecision.explanation: Owner explicitly approved the repeating long_form → long_form → short cycle without a weekly publication target. Each consecutive actual publication must be at least 72 elapsed hours apart and must not share an Africa/Johannesburg calendar day. Three cycle gaps require at least 216 hours.

spacingPolicy.explanation: Two long-form videos followed by one Short repeat in a rolling cycle. Each consecutive actual publication must be at least 72 elapsed hours apart, so a complete three-gap cycle requires at least 216 hours. No weekly publication count is promised.

publicationCycle.description: Rolling three-publication sequence: long-form, long-form, Short. Each next actual publication waits at least 72 elapsed hours from the prior actual publication; the earliest full cycle is 216 hours (9 days), not a weekly target.

antiSpamPolicy.note: No bot-driven likes, comments, replies, follows, DMs, engagement exchanges, artificial views/clicks, or unsolicited outreach. Human-initiated genuine interaction is outside automation and must comply with platform rules.
